title: rhinanthus asperulus grex illyricus
intro: Rhinanthus asperulus grex illyricus, commonly known as Illyrian Yellow Rattle, is a plant species belonging to the Orobanchaceae family. It is a hemiparasitic plant that obtains some of its nutrients by connecting to the roots of other plants, particularly grasses. The Illyrian Yellow Rattle has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs due to its expectorant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
